summary: Phase 9 MANDATORY PROBE GATE, dispatch 3 of 3 (FINAL, hard cap exhausted). Settles the single question dispatch 2 left open -- whether a compound (disjunctive) context assumption is reachable in the derivations nik_adequacy must cover -- WITHOUT needing to inspect cs5_completeness's canonical construction (dispatch 2's suggested next step). Reading Deduction.lean's NIK constructor signatures directly shows impI/orE/diaE extend Gamma with a fully unrestricted Proposition (no atomicity side-condition anywhere), so nik_adequacy's own established signature (quantifying over EVERY Gamma, no x-in-G.X / labels(Gamma)-subset-G.X restriction) forces the assumption case to handle a literally-compound fact, independent of what any particular caller instantiates. Wrote probes/theta_place_final_gate.lean (scratch, outside Cslib/), machine-checking: (1) compound_assumption_derivation -- a genuine closed NIK TS5 term (not a hypothesis) discharging a literally-compound (P0-or-P1) context assumption via ordinary impI, at depth 1 below root, reusing dispatch 1/2's Gt2/c2/ht2 case-D graph verbatim -- the concrete reachability witness; (2) hOrFlat_concrete -- NOT a hypothesis this time (dispatch 2's analogous fact was an assumed hypothesis): concretely DERIVED, by unfolding sigAt's actual factsAt-fold at c2 via the landed Preserved-Asset sigAtFuel/bigAndL machinery, that Theta(Gt2,GammaCompound,r) implies ONLY the flat box(P0-or-P1), never the split box-P0-or-box-P1, for exactly the reachable Gamma from (1); (3) caseD_assumption_needs_bridge composes these, showing closing the split-form obligation needs exactly the established non-theorem bridge (not re-derived or re-litigated, per the hard instruction), with no alternative route found. Sorry-free, axiom-clean (propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx), compiles at exit 0. Cslib/ untouched (verified via git status --short Cslib/ before and after commit; a concurrent, unrelated agent's edits elsewhere in Cslib/ were neither staged nor committed by this dispatch). FINAL GATE VERDICT: (b) GATE FAIL, definitive -- see continuation_context.phase_9_gate_verdict below for full justification.

blockers.what_was_tried: Read Deduction.lean's NIK inductive definition directly (impI/orE/diaE constructors, Deduction.lean:271-306) to confirm Gamma-extension is unrestricted in the underlying calculus -- settles reachability without inspecting cs5_completeness. Built a genuine NIK derivation (impI discharging assumption of P0-or-P1, both atoms) proving the unremarkable theorem c2:(P0-or-P1) implies (P0-or-P1). Concretely derived (not hypothesized) that Theta at this Gamma implies only the flat boxed form, via sigAt's own factsAt-fold (sigAtFuel_ΓCompound_c2_imp, sigAt_r_imp_box_sigAtFuel_c2), using plain conjunct-membership extraction (bigAndL_mem, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_toList) rather than explicit toFinset/toList computation.
blockers.root_cause: sigAt's WHOLESALE (non-recursive) factsAt-fold cannot see inside a context fact's own top connective -- it boxes a context fact up the tree exactly as given, regardless of whether that fact is itself a disjunction. place's own or-recursion (dispatch 2's redesign) only ever sees a disjunction AT THE POINT place is applied to a TARGET formula (e.g. after orI1/orI2 introduction), never retroactively inside Theta's CONTEXT-fact folding. Since nik_adequacy's assumption case is forced (by NIK's own unrestricted impI/orE/diaE and nik_adequacy's own established, unrestricted-Gamma signature) to cover exactly this scenario, the layered place redesign cannot close it without the non-theorem bridge.
blockers.what_is_needed: Task-level re-plan decision between two options, neither attempted in this dispatch (both exceed Phase 9's shape-validation remit): (i) lift the sigAt-frozen postmortem constraint and redesign Theta's context-fold to split compound facts recursively (genuine new infrastructure, comparable in scope to Phase 12-19's own remit); or (ii) abandon the target-independent-Theta strategy for the alternative nikTr-per-label route already partially landed in Soundness.lean, where sigAt_assumption (already landed, sorry-free) closes the assumption case for FREE for ANY formula (compound or not) since it concludes AT the assumption's own label with no boxing at all -- but that route has its own, DIFFERENT, already-documented obstruction instead (efq/orE's cross-label lowest-common-ancestor bridging, Soundness.lean:1889-1911), not adjudicated by this dispatch.

Constructed the reachability witness via the simplest possible impI+assumption instance (proving (P0-or-P1) implies (P0-or-P1)) rather than a more elaborate derivation, since the simplicity itself is part of the point: this is not an exotic edge case, it is the syntactically simplest use of impI.

Reported the true, honest outcome (definitive GATE FAIL) rather than searching for a way to manufacture a PASS, per the hard-mode instruction against weakening a statement to force a case to pass -- consistent with dispatch 1/2's own honesty discipline.

Did NOT attempt either of the two next-redesign options (modifying sigAt, or switching to the nikTr-per-label route) -- both are task-level scope decisions exceeding Phase 9's remit and requiring a re-plan, not a further probe dispatch.
